description:
draft-ietf-jmap-metadata has been rewritten from -01 to -02. The -02 draft is a COMPLETE architectural rewrite that eliminates the standalone Metadata object type entirely.

**-01 model (what we built):** Metadata is a standalone JMAP object type with its own Metadata/get, Metadata/set, Metadata/query, Metadata/queryChanges, Metadata/changes methods. The Metadata type is a #[serde(tag = "@type")] enum over Annotation/ImapMetadata/WebDavMetadata variants with common properties (id, relatedType, relatedId, isPrivate).

**-02 model (what the spec now says):** Metadata is NOT a standalone type. Instead, each opted-in JMAP data type gains two new properties: 'metadata' (shared) and 'privateMetadata' (per-user). Values are objects keyed by namespace identifier. Clients use the EXISTING /get, /set, /changes, /query methods on the parent type to read/modify metadata — no separate Metadata/* methods exist.

**Impact on workspace crates:**
- jmap-metadata-types: Complete rewrite. Metadata enum (Annotation/ImapMetadata/WebDavMetadata) is eliminated. Need new types for namespace-keyed metadata properties. MetadataFilterCondition may need rework for inline query support.
- jmap-metadata-server: Complete rewrite. All 5 standalone method handlers (handle_metadata_get/set/query/queryChanges/changes) are eliminated. MetadataBackend trait needs redesign. MemoryBackend needs redesign. The metadata capability now augments existing type handlers rather than registering its own.
- jmap-metadata-client: Complete rewrite. All 5 client methods are eliminated. New API surface for metadata-augmented requests on existing types.
- AGENTS.md references, bd memories, and test suites all need updating.

**Spec file:** ~/PROJECT/jmap-chat-spec/references/draft-ietf-jmap-metadata-02.txt

This is a P1 because the published crates (0.1.1) implement a spec revision that no longer exists. The -02 rewrite is incompatible with -01 at every level — types, methods, wire format.
title: Align metadata crates with draft-ietf-jmap-metadata-02
